name: Nasus
title: The Curator of the Sands

q.name: Siphoning Strike

description.normalized: Empowers next attack within 10 seconds to deal an additional 20 / 50 / 80 / 110 physical damage. If Siphoning Strike kills the target, its damage is permanently increased by 5. Killing champions, large minions and large monsters increases Siphoning Strike's damage by 14 instead.

w.name: Wither

description.normalized: Slows enemy Movement Speed by 35% and Attack Speed by 22.49% / 29.98% / 37.48% / 44.96% for 5 seconds. The Movement Speed slow increases to 45% / 60% / 75% / 90% over the duration.

e.name: Spirit Fire

description.normalized: Creates a flaming zone, dealing 55 / 110 / 165 / 220 (+40% AP) magic damage. The zone persists for 5 seconds, dealing 11 / 22 / 33 / 44 (+12% AP) magic damage over time and reducing Armor by 20% / 25% / 30% / 35%.

r.name: Fury of the Sands
